headline: The MNB meets again, but may wait due to risks – When will the time for rate cuts come?
summary: The Monetary Council of the Hungarian National Bank meets Tuesday and is expected to keep its base rate at 5.5% due to global risks, despite favourable domestic inflation trends.
why: The Hungarian National Bank sets the forint base rate, which influences borrowing costs, the currency and the valuation of domestic assets.
